model.name: v10 c200 FP8
model.training: 200 steps, lora_rank=64, freeze_vit=false, v9b trajectory injected into prompts
model.selection_reason: more-trained alternative to c150; tests whether longer training improves over the empirical local optimum

purpose: Final disambiguation: is c150 the local F1 optimum, or does more training improve? c50 already shown flat vs c150 (agg F1 0.333 vs 0.329, within noise; lost goal precision on new venues). c200 vs c150 will decide: (a) c200 > c150 → continue-train v11 with longer schedule; (b) c200 ≤ c150 → c150 confirmed local opt → pivot to v11 with richer features OR hybrid (c150 goal/save + v8 everything else).

targets.success_criteria: new-venue goal recall > 4/16 OR aggregate F1 > 0.40
targets.iteration_signals: If c200 keeps c150's precision-clean goal on game_20 AND lifts agg F1 > 0.34, c200 is the new pick. If c200 introduces goal FPs like c50 did, c150 wins.
targets.decision_after_c200: Pick best F1 among {c50, c150, c200} that retains precision-1.00 goal detection. Then move to v11 (richer features OR longer schedule) OR hybrid (v10-best for goal/save + v8 for everything else).

next_run: TBD after c200 eval. Three plausible paths: (1) v11 LoRA with velocity/acceleration trajectory features; (2) continue-train v10 with lower LR for 200+ more steps; (3) hybrid v10+v8 portfolio.
